description: Sri Lanka Customs - rates of Exchange w.e.t. 22.12.2025 to 28.12.2025
reasoning: This gazette is a Customs Notification issued under the authority of the Customs Ordinance (Chapter 235). Its primary content is the establishment of new legal/regulatory rates of exchange for calculating customs duties and other charges. It rescinds a previous legal notice and publishes a detailed schedule of currency rates. This fits the definition of a Legal/Regulatory Gazette (Type 5), which includes statutory instruments, regulations, and legal notices that establish or modify regulatory frameworks.
